description:
Welcome to Crash Course Big Questions on U.S Government! In this series, we’ll be exploring big questions and misconceptions about how our government operates, from partisan divisions and Congressional gridlock to stolen elections and the limits of presidential power.

Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1naWmymw68W9x6GAix9e4jTrEIRXT0-F3IniP3LSscOo/edit?tab=t.0

For supplemental resources related to the topics covered in this episode, check out: https://usafacts.org/crash-course/
